decision: FALSIFIES — The truncation-artifact hypothesis is decisively falsified. Full-DOM canonical recipe ranking agreement for tag_entropy x DEF-FULL-MAP is 37.26%, which is 18.69pp BELOW the truncated-first-20 baseline (55.95%) and far below all preregistered thresholds (C5: 60.95%, C6: 75%). Per-task agreement collapses from 78.65% to 11.41% (−67.24pp). The ranking instability is NOT a truncation artifact; it WORSENS with full DOM elements. F1 and F2 both trigger. The hypothesis (H1 >=80%, H2 >=+10pp, H3 >=85%) is falsified across all three conditions. Controls pass (PC1 eta2=1.0, NC1 eta2=0.0, C4 max eta2=0.99996), confirming the pipeline is functioning; the negative result is scientific, not infrastructural. Audit REVISE corrects B3 non-recipe ranking preservation (actually 0% for tag_entropy/form_fraction due to direct vs pipeline ranking inversion), within-type clone degeneracy (identical locatable_samples per type inflate discrimination), and hash salt non-determinism — none change the falsification direction. The Bootstrap CI is degenerate [0,1] due to binary ranking agreement across bootstraps with N=7 tasks, consistent with within-type clone degeneracy.

claim_updates.reason: The ranking instability under recipe sampling is falsified as a truncation artifact: full DOM elements DEGRADE canonical agreement from 55.95% to 37.26% (−18.69pp) and collapse per-task agreement from 78.65% to 11.41% (−67.24pp). F1 triggers (37.26% < 75%), F2 triggers (full DOM does NOT exceed truncated by >=5pp; it is 18.7pp BELOW). The hypothesis that the truncated-first-20 subsample was the binding constraint is falsified for this site/definition/recipe/feature combination. The ranking instability is structural, not truncation-dependent. Additional DOM elements introduce noise that dilutes discriminative signal rather than enriching it. Bounded to: single Magento site (am1n3e/webarena-verified-shopping), 7 tasks (3 listing n=82, 3 detail n=32, 1 cart n=21), definitions DEF-FULL-MAP/DEF-FORM-ONLY, recipes canonical/pertask, features tag_entropy/form_fraction/total_area, viewport 1280x720, seed 99. Non-recipe pipeline discrimination preserved (eta2 0.99996) but non-recipe pipeline does NOT preserve direct ranking for tag_entropy/form_fraction on full DOM (inversion detected by audit VF3). No cross-site, cross-definition, or cross-viewport generalization warranted.

product_action: Recipe density path is permanently closed for this definition x recipe x feature framework on template-homogeneous sites. Product lane must use non-recipe density only for MIXED handling. The non-recipe pipeline preserves discrimination (eta2 > 0.999) but does NOT preserve direct page-type ranking for tag_entropy/form_fraction on full DOM (inversion: detail > listing direct vs listing > detail pipeline). total_area is the only feature where non-recipe preserves ranking. Product lane should evaluate: (1) whether total_area-based non-recipe density is sufficient for MIXED handling economics; (2) whether the 31x recipe material gap (EXP-INTEL-35264637598) is actionable under non-recipe density; (3) whether the direct vs pipeline ranking inversion on tag_entropy/form_fraction is a general phenomenon or specific to this Magento template homogeneity.
next_question: Given that recipe density is permanently closed for this framework, should the Product lane evaluate total_area-based non-recipe density for MIXED handling economics (eta2 > 0.999 but no recipe sampling), or should the Intel lane investigate the mechanism of ranking degradation with full DOM to determine whether alternative element-selection strategies (e.g., feature-discriminative subsampling rather than canonical recipe) could recover stability?
reason: The falsification is decisive: canonical agreement 37.26% < 75% (F1), full DOM does NOT exceed truncated (−18.7pp vs required +5pp, F2), per-task 11.41% < 75% (F3). Controls pass confirming pipeline function. Audit findings (B3 correction, clone degeneracy, hash salt) are confirmatory of structural instability. The mechanism is likely signal dilution: the original truncated-first-20 accidentally captured a relatively stable element subset; adding all 1550+ elements per listing page floods the recipe sampling with non-discriminative elements. Within-type clone homogeneity (all 3 listing tasks have identical tag distributions) means the ranking instability is entirely driven by recipe sampling randomness, not genuine page-type variance. The non-recipe ceiling (100% for total_area, 0% for tag_entropy/form_fraction due to inversion) reveals that the pipeline's density normalization by elements_with_bbox (1550-1564 listing vs 1143-1215 detail) distorts feature-density ranking when ewb differs systematically by page type.
